craft_notes: Sthāyin: craving acquitted. Rows: portrait then verdict. Read aloud: clearing.

lines: The waverer, not quite full, other-wise formed, astir,
deedless, mere craving — to be bounding-fit hereafter —
is no taint of man, nor another real.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram
